patch_description: Replace the reverse chain of unparametrized CZ gates with parametrized CRZ gates sharing a single parameter "crz_rev". This adds minimal overhead (1 new parameter) while increasing expressivity of the reverse entanglement path. The shared parameter approach maintains the excellent generalization gap (0.01) seen in the current program while potentially improving accuracy by allowing the model to learn optimal phase rotations for the reverse chain, similar to how the hub-spoke topology in the second program (score 0.87) used parametrized CRY gates to boost validation accuracy to 0.89.
